text: DSH Plugin Updates 为 DSH 网页端检查第三方插件的新版本，并在右侧栏、插件设置页和左侧插件图标提供更新入口。它读取已安装插件的版本并查询 npm registry，支持查看其他 profile、手动检查、单项更新和批量更新；更新由 DSH 插件管理器执行。适合希望在 DSH 内集中查看插件更新的用户。无需 API 密钥；版本查询会向 npm registry 发送插件包名。

DSH Plugin Updates checks third-party plugins for newer versions in the DSH web client. It adds panels to the right sidebar and Plugins page, plus a left-sidebar badge. Users can check and update plugins through DSH. No API key is needed; registry lookups send package names to npm registries.
想在 DSH 里查看已装插件有没有新版本。
能不能从插件页面直接更新过期的第三方插件？
我想一次检查并批量更新 DSH 插件，也能看看其他 profile 的版本。
DSH Plugin Updates 的功能「插件版本检查」：页面打开时读取已安装的第三方插件并查询注册表 latest 版本，生成状态列表；页面可见时还会定期复查，也支持手动刷新。
DSH Plugin Updates 的功能「单项或批量更新」：确认单个插件后调用 DSH 插件管理器移除旧版并安装 latest；批量操作逐个处理可更新项目，并在失败时尝试恢复原版本。
DSH Plugin Updates 使用前须知：版本检查会向 registry.npmjs.org 查询插件包名，失败时尝试 registry.npmmirror.com；没有代码证据表明会发送会话内容。

@moyumole/dsh-plugin-updates README · Features：- **Three entry points, one panel**
  - Right sidebar → "Start / Guide" → "Plugin updates" card (red dot when updates are available)
  - Plugins page → "Plugin updates" tab (global, no open Session required)
  - Left-sidebar "Plugins" icon badge (clicking it still opens the Plugins page)
- **Checks**: once on page load; while the page is visible it re-checks every 30 minutes (hidden pages pause the timer and catch up on return), plus manual refresh. Registry answers are cached for 10 minutes. Only third-party bundles are checked (`official !== true`, `availability === 'profile'`, `installed === true`), excluding this plugin itself.
- **All profiles (read-only)**: a section lists the third-party plugins of the other DSH profiles on this machine with the same update status logic. It is informational only — those profiles are never changed from here; open that profile's window or use `dsh plugin --profile <name> ...` to act on them.
- **Updates**: "Update" for one bundle or "Update all", both through the official plugin manager (`removeBundle` → `installBundle(name@latest, { enabled })`). "Update all" skips large packages (unpacked over 3

@moyumole/dsh-plugin-updates README · Usage：Open the panel from any of: the right sidebar ("Start" → "Plugin updates"), "Settings → Plugins" → "Plugin updates" tab, or the left-sidebar Plugins icon.

@moyumole/dsh-plugin-updates README · Usage：| State | What you see |
|---|---|
| Update available | current version → latest version, "Update" button enabled |
| Up to date | "Up to date", no button |
| Incompatible | latest version's `engines.dsh` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer range rejects the current DSH version; the update button is disabled by default |
| Check failed | only that row is marked failed; a network failure keeps the previous results and can be retried |
| Non-npm source | bundles whose `source` is not an npm dependency (git, local path, …) are marked "update not supported" |

@moyumole/dsh-plugin-updates README · Usage：Update flow: `removeBundle(name)` → `installBundle(name@latest, { enabled })`. This really changes the profile's `package.json` / `pnpm-lock.yaml` / `node_modules`, and the plugin is briefly unavailable while it is removed and reinstalled. Updated browser-side code usually takes effect after a refresh or a DSH restart. **Confirm the target version before updating** — updating is an npm supply-chain action.

@moyumole/dsh-plugin-updates README · Permissions and external services：- **Permissions**: no DSH permission is requested. The browser half only registers UI. The Host half reads `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/*/package.json` and the installed versions under each profile's `node_modules`, and exposes that inventory as a read-only JSON route (`/plugin-updates/profiles`) on the local web server. It never writes to a profile, never installs or removes anything, and the payload contains only profile names plus third-party package names/versions (no paths, credentials or session data)
- **External services**: read-only npm registry requests (`registry.npmjs.org`, falling back to `registry.npmmirror.com`) for `<name>/latest`; the only data sent is the package name of installed third-party bundles
- **Local operations**: updates are executed by the official DSH plugin manager; this plugin does not run shell commands or write files itself
- **Telemetry**: none
- Full threat model and residual risks: [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md)

@moyumole/dsh-plugin-updates README · Known limitations：- The "All profiles" section is read-only: it reports the other profiles' plugin versions, but updates must be performed in that profile's own window (or with `dsh plugin --profile <name> ...`).
- The DSH version is tied to the running installation, not to a profile: profiles opened by the same DSH app share one version; profiles opened by a different install (for example the npm CLI) can differ.
- The right sidebar is a per-Session column: with no Session open, use "Settings → Plugins → Plugin updates".
- If the host removes or renames a Remote method (for example `installBundle`), the panel shows a localized "plugin manager is not available" banner and updates fail on that row instead of throwing an obscure error.
- Large packages (unpacked over 30 MB) are excluded from "Update all"; update them individually. A single large update can take minutes, and a slow download can still exceed the host's install window — use the official Plugins page or the CLI in that case.
- The left-sidebar badge shadows the host's "Plugins" icon cell (`sidebar.panellist`, `priority: -1`); a host redesign may require a visual sync, but functionali

@moyumole/dsh-plugin-updates README · Development：```powershell
cd dsh-plugin-updates
node scripts/build-client.mjs         # generate lib/client.js from lib/src/*.js
node scripts/build-client.mjs --check # verify the bundle is up to date
node --test test/*.test.mjs           # unit / UI / bundle consistency tests

@moyumole/dsh-plugin-updates README · Development：The browser half is a generated single file because DSH loads exactly one `./client` entry per package and cannot import sibling files at runtime. `lib/src/*.js` is plain testable ESM; the build script only strips imports/exports and concatenates — no bundler and no third-party dependency. `lib/client.js` is committed so installation never builds. CI and `prepublishOnly` verify freshness.

@moyumole/dsh-plugin-updates README · Development：| File | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | Host half: read-only scan of the other profiles, served as `GET /plugin-updates/profiles` |
| `lib/src/entry.js` | Slot registration and wiring (right-sidebar tab / Guide card / Plugins tab / left badge / toast / visible-page timer) |
| `lib/src/schedule.js` | Pure auto-check scheduling policy (30 minutes, skip while busy) |
| `lib/src/controller.js` | Panel state machine, Remote calls, rollback, progress and toasts |
| `lib/src/rows.js` | BundleInfo + registry manifest → panel rows |
| `lib/src/registry.js` | npm registry fetch, validation, 10-minute cache |
| `lib/src/compatibility.js` | `engines.dsh` / peer compatibility rules |
| `lib/src/semver.js` | Version and range comparison (includePrerelease) |
| `lib/src/i18n.js` | English and Chinese dictionaries |
| `lib/src/ui.js` | React panel, Guide card, tab title, icon, toast |
| `lib/client.js` | **Generated**: all of the above concatenated into one browser bundle |

@moyumole/dsh-plugin-updates README · Releasing (maintainers)：Releasing is two steps: **bump the version, push a tag**. The tag triggers `release.yml`, which runs the tests, creates the GitHub Release from the matching CHANGELOG section, and publishes to npm via **Trusted Publishing (OIDC)** — no long-lived npm secret is stored in the repository.

```powershell

@moyumole/dsh-plugin-updates README · tag and push — npm + GitHub Release happen automatically：git tag vX.Y.Z
git push origin vX.Y.Z
```

- npm uses `npm publish --provenance`; the release is skipped when the version already exists.
- A manual fallback exists: Actions → `publish` → Run workflow (requires the `NPM_TOKEN` secret; not needed with Trusted Publishing).
- If the npm account uses 2FA for direct publishing, use a granular token with 2FA bypass for local publishes (`.npmrc` with `//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${NODE_AUTH_TOKEN}` is git-ignored).

@moyumole/dsh-plugin-updates README · 中文：**在 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）内检查当前 profile 中第三方插件的 npm 新版本，并在面板里一键更新**——右侧栏页面、插件页标签、左侧栏红点三个入口，同一个面板。

@moyumole/dsh-plugin-updates README · 功能：- **三处入口，同一个面板**
  - 右侧栏「开始 / Guide」→「插件更新」卡片（有可用更新时卡片和 tab 标题显示红点）
  - 「设置 → 插件」页顶部的「插件更新」标签（全局，无需打开会话）
  - 左侧栏「插件」图标右上角红点（点击仍进入「插件」页）
- **检查**：页面加载时自动检查一次；**页面可见时每 30 分钟自动再检查一次**（切到后台暂停，回到前台若已过期立即补一次）；也支持手动「刷新」；npm registry 结果缓存 10 分钟；只检查 `official !== true`、`availability === 'profile'`、`installed === true` 的第三方 bundle，并排除本插件自身
- **所有 Profile（只读）**：面板下方列出本机其他 profile 的第三方插件更新状况（复用同一套状态判断）。这里**只展示、不修改**；要更新请打开对应 profile 的窗口，或用 `dsh plugin --profile <name> ...`。
- **更新**：单个「更新」或「全部更新」；通过 DSH 官方插件管理器执行 `removeBundle` → `installBundle(name@latest, { enabled })`。「全部更新」会跳过大型插件（解包超过 30 MB，例如约 71 MB 的 `dsh-pet`）并在结果里提示；这些请在对应行单独更新。
- **进度与提示**：更新时显示阶段文案（移除旧版 / 安装新版 / 应用 / 回滚）与进度条（单个为不确定进度，全部更新为 done/total）；结束时顶部居中弹出结果 toast（成功 / 失败 / 回滚 / 批量汇总，自动消失、可手动关闭）
- **失败处理**：安装失败时尽力回滚到旧版本；回滚也失败时保留可关闭的错误提示，并重新读取真实安装状态，保证 UI 与磁盘一致
- **不常驻**：无后台进程、无服务、无计划任务；30 分钟定时器只在页面可见时存在（隐藏即清除）；不自动重启 DSH
- **多语言**：自动跟随 DSH 界面语言——宿主 locale 以 `zh` 开头时显示中文，否则英文；切换语言后界面文案、卡片/标签、toast 以及「上次检查」的时间格式都会即时更新

- **遥测**：无

@moyumole/dsh-plugin-updates README · 验收状态（诚实声明）：自动化测试：`node --test test/*.test.mjs`（119 项，覆盖版本比较、兼容性、registry 回退/缓存/输入加固、行构建、大插件保护、controller 状态机与回滚、宿主能力缺失、自动复查调度策略、跨 profile 清点与路由、UI 渲染与样式约束、bundle 一致性）；CI 还会校验生成物与源码一致。

@moyumole/dsh-plugin-updates README · 已知限制：- 「所有 Profile」区块是只读的：只报告其他 profile 的插件版本，更新必须在对应 profile 的窗口中完成（或使用 `dsh plugin --profile <name> ...`）。
- DSH 版本取决于运行中的应用/运行时，而不是 profile：同一 DSH 安装打开的 profile 共享一个版本；由不同安装（例如 npm 版 CLI）打开的 profile 可能不同。
- 右侧栏是按会话存在的列：没有打开会话时请用「设置 → 插件 → 插件更新」。
- 若宿主删除或重命名了 Remote 方法（例如 `installBundle`），面板会显示本地化的「插件管理器不可用」错误横幅，更新会按失败处理，而不是抛出难以理解的异常。
- 大型插件（解包超过 30 MB）不会进入「全部更新」，请逐个更新。单个大插件安装也可能需要数分钟；如果下载过慢、超出宿主的安装窗口，请改用官方插件页或 CLI。
- 左侧栏红点通过遮蔽宿主「插件」图标单元实现（`sidebar.panellist` 的 `plugins` 单元，`priority: -1`）；宿主大改该图标时外观需要同步，功能不受影响。
- 只支持 npm registry（官方源 + npmmirror 回退），不支持私有 registry。
- 不检查、不更新 DSH 本体；不管理官方随附 bundle（`@deepseek-ai/*`）。
- 不列出本插件自身（避免更新过程中面板消失）；如需更新本插件请用官方插件页。
- 不自动重启 DSH；刷新页面后检查结果会重新获取（缓存仅保存在内存）。自动复查只在页面可见时进行，后台标签页不消耗资源。
- 更新失败回滚依赖官方插件管理器对 `package.json` / lockfile 的恢复语义；回滚失败属于不可恢复场景，需要手动重装。

@moyumole/dsh-plugin-updates README · 开发：```powershell
cd dsh-plugin-updates
node scripts/build-client.mjs         # 由 lib/src/*.js 生成 lib/client.js（浏览器单文件 bundle）
node scripts/build-client.mjs --check # 校验生成物是否最新
node --test test/*.test.mjs           # 单元/UI/bundle 一致性测试

为什么浏览器端是生成物：DSH 的客户端加载器每个包只加载一个 `./client` 入口文件，无法在运行时 `import` 同包的其他文件。`lib/src/*.js` 是可单测的普通 ESM，构建脚本只做「剥掉 import/export + 拼接」，不引入任何打包器或第三方依赖；生成后的 `lib/client.js` 直接提交，安装时无需构建。CI 与 `prepublishOnly` 会校验生成物与源码一致。

源码结构：

@moyumole/dsh-plugin-updates README · 开发：| 文件 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | Host 半边：只读扫描其他 profile，并以 `GET /plugin-updates/profiles` 提供 JSON |
| `lib/src/entry.js` | 槽注册与接线（右侧栏 tab / Guide 卡片 / 插件页 tab / 左侧栏红点 / toast / 可见页定时器） |
| `lib/src/schedule.js` | 纯自动复查调度策略（30 分钟、忙时跳过） |
| `lib/src/controller.js` | 面板状态机、Remote 调用、回滚、进度与 toast |
| `lib/src/rows.js` | BundleInfo + registry manifest → 列表行 |
| `lib/src/registry.js` | npm registry 拉取、校验与 10 分钟缓存 |
| `lib/src/compatibility.js` | `engines.dsh` / peer 兼容性判定 |
| `lib/src/semver.js` | 版本与范围比较（includePrerelease） |
| `lib/src/i18n.js` | 中英文字典 |
| `lib/src/ui.js` | React 面板、Guide 卡片、tab 标题、图标、toast |
| `lib/client.js` | **生成物**：上面所有 src 拼成的单文件浏览器 bundle |

```powershell

@moyumole/dsh-plugin-updates README · 打 tag 并推送 —— npm 发布 + GitHub Release 自动完成：git tag vX.Y.Z
git push origin vX.Y.Z
```

- npm 使用 `npm publish --provenance`，版本已存在时自动跳过。
- 手动备用：Actions → `publish` → Run workflow（需要 `NPM_TOKEN` secret，用 Trusted Publishing 时不需要）。
- 若 npm 账号对直接发布开启 2FA，本地发布请用带 2FA bypass 的 granular token（`.npmrc` 里 `//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${NODE_AUTH_TOKEN}`，已被 git 忽略）。
